integrity: Finite exact enumeration supports the algebra and is not a substitute for the martingale functional limit or uniqueness and localization arguments. Source priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Uniform perfect matchings of linearly ordered endpoints only; joint weak limit rather than a finite-size rate or moment convergence. The classical Chernoff law and global matching-cut Gaussian bridge are prior work; the claim is the matching-specific local law and argmax localization. General maximum-process literature may contain an equivalent unlocated specialization.
title: A Chernoff location law for the busiest cut in a random chord diagram
